## Checklist

- [ ] PR title and commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat:`, `fix:`, ...)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (`main_test.go` or `test/kind.sh`)
- [ ] Docs, `values.yaml` comments and `values.schema.json` updated if flags/values changed
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
